rows.label: a plain word
rows.correction: q RANKS, it does not FILTER. 133,375 is the rankable pool, not 'results for letter'.

rows.label: a nonsense word
rows.correction: A meaningless word returns the same 133,375 — the total ignores q entirely.

rows.label: a real filter
rows.correction: The filter changes the count to 62,285 — 71,090 fewer than the q total. The filter, not the word, moves it.

rows.label: a filter + impossible id
rows.correction: An impossible id narrows the count to 0 — the filter is what cuts it, never q.

docs_line: You want to scrape a large result set (>10,000 records).
